actual_cache_EN_narration: And the search space explodes. <bookmark mark='a'/> 7 blocks can be stacked 37,633 different ways. <bookmark mark='b'/> On random 7-block problems, breadth-first search records 19,742 expanded states on average. <bookmark mark='c'/> The cure is chapter four's idea: relax the problem. Ignore delete lists, then compute cheap approximations to the remaining cost; finding the shortest relaxed plan is still NP-hard. With admissible h max, A* returns an optimal plan when it solves this unit-cost task. With h max, the observed mean is 5,415 expanded states. <bookmark mark='d'/> Inspired by Hoffmann and Nebel's FF planner of 2001, our FF-style heuristic counts distinct actions in an extracted relaxed plan. Greedy search records 31 expanded states on average. The matched comparison is this: On the 12 matched problems both breadth-first and greedy solved at 7 blocks, greedy's mean plan length is 15.3 steps against the optimum's 11.3. Check completion as well: Every recorded attempt here solved its task; the panel also shows unrun or unknown cases. Such heuristics, Graphplan, and planning as satisfiability made general planners practical.
actual_cache_ZH_narration: 而且搜索空间会爆炸。<bookmark mark='a'/>7块积木，可以叠成37633种不同的摆法。<bookmark mark='b'/>在随机的7块积木问题上，广度优先搜索记录的平均扩展数为19742个状态。<bookmark mark='c'/>解药还是第4章的想法：放松问题。忽略删除表，再廉价地近似估计剩余代价；寻找最短的放松计划，仍然是NP难的。使用可采纳的h max时，A星如果解出了这个每步代价相同的问题，返回的计划就是最优的。使用h max时，观察到的平均扩展数为5415个状态。<bookmark mark='d'/>受霍夫曼和内贝尔2001年的FF规划器启发，我们的FF式启发式从一个放松计划中数出不重复的动作。贪心搜索记录的平均扩展数为31个状态。配对比较如下：在7块积木时，两种方法都解出的12个相同问题上，贪心计划平均长15.3步，最优计划平均长11.3步。还要看完成情况：这里每一次有记录的尝试都解出了任务；面板还列出了未运行或情况未知的项。这样的启发式、Graphplan，以及把规划当作可满足性问题，让通用规划器变得实用。
